column1: # Ingredient-line corpus for IngredientParser, written for Self Watch in the style of MyPlate and
# common recipe sites. Columns (tab separated): line, amountX100, unit, words, note, package.
# "-" means null. package is "<amountX100> <unit>". Lines starting with # are comments.
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
freshly ground black pepper, to taste
1 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped
1 tablespoon sugar plus more to taste
